fields.statement: Leaf cold-run-ship-scripts-cut, attempt 2: two of its wall-time points are out of reach inside the leaf's files (cmd/rhiza/main_test.go, run-ship scripts) and must_not. (1) Three-package wall at most 60% of base: attempt 1 measured 373.11 s against base 496.88 s (75.1%); internal/api alone is 370 s of it, outside this leaf's files, and the brief forbids editing internal/api here. Reaching 60% needs internal/api at about 298 s or less. (2) cmd/rhiza's own package time at most 60% of base (231.001 s, so at most 138.6 s): attempt 1 182.4 s (verifier 186.5 s, 79.0%). Attempt 2 measured go test -trimpath -count=1 -p 2 -parallel 8 ./cmd/rhiza (the -parallel make test already passes) at ok 161.516 s, 162.68 s wall, 203.28 user + 182.68 sys = 385.96 CPU-s (load 4 at start, 9.7 at end from other sessions): the box is CPU-bound at about 2.4 of 4 cores, and even perfect packing of that CPU on 4 cores is about 97 s. The CPU is in child processes, not the test process (earlier strace: about 36 of about 370 CPU-s in the test process; about 107k child processes, 44k of them git and 6k rhiza). Attempt 2's strace of run-ship-ci-fix: 1872 execs, 383 fsyncs costing 0.34 s of a 16 s script, so there are no I/O waits for the harness to remove. Harness levers already used: GOMAXPROCS=1, git auto-maintenance and gc off, GOGC=off with GOMEMLIMIT=48MiB. tmpfs and GOGC=off at 128MiB were tried and did not help. What is left is production code: git calls per command, about 14 ms of startup per rhiza process (internal/web init) and sqlite index opens. Ruling scripts-cpu-cut-accept-short-of-15 already put those outside a test-harness leaf. (3) user+sys at most 60% of base: 617.71 s against 857.92 s (72.0%), with internal/api's CPU in it. One harness change could move the cmd/rhiza number: making a plain go test ./cmd/rhiza run scripts at -parallel min(2*NPROC,8) when -parallel is not given, as make test does. It still misses (161.5 s against 138.6 s). It also would not shorten the cold make test the milestone measures, since make test already passes -parallel 8, so I have not made it. Ruling asked: accept the leaf at attempt 1's measured cut, its 60% wall points not met and not lowered, with internal/api's wall and the scripts' child-process CPU (git calls, rhiza startup) planned as their own change sets; or name a cut inside this leaf's files and must_not to build.
